+## Pricing
+Three plans, billed monthly or yearly with two months free on the yearly plan.
+- Starter: $12 per seat per month, up to 5 seats, community support.
+- Team: $29 per seat per month, unlimited seats, priority email support, SSO add-on.
+- Enterprise: talk to sales for volume discounts, a dedicated success manager and a custom contract.
+Every plan starts with a 14-day trial, no card required. Nonprofits and schools get 50% off.
+## Why teams switch
+Customers tell us they switched because onboarding took an afternoon instead of a quarter,
+and because the pricing stays flat as the team grows instead of jumping at each tier.
